cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Can you tell me the winning cake temperature without becoming my co-baker?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want my secret recipe too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Only the degree at which my original idea should happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the temperature quietly so my achievement can concentrate.

mechanism: A sets the terms on which B may supply a needed advantage, reserving ownership of the eventual achievement while deciding how assistance may be named.
confusable: Ordinary credit denial is confusable: A must actively seek the specific advantage rather than merely resent credit after receiving it.
comparison: Tennis loan negotiates acknowledgment of equipment; cake temperature negotiates expertise without admitting co-authorship.
seedUse: Read both full instructions and all four canonical seeds. Preserve the real dependency and B credit challenge, making A control of acknowledgment the Stance method.
